title: DEF CON 29 - Richard Henderson - Old MacDonald Had a Barcode, E I E I CAR
summary: A DEF CON 29 talk by Richard Henderson about encoding the EICAR antivirus test string into QR codes and barcodes and scanning them at real systems. Many systems that do not expect such input misbehave or collapse, including a parking garage system.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an entertaining demonstration of how scanners and antivirus software fail on unexpected input.

quote.text: This guy put the EICAR test string into a barcode and started to scan it on various systems, with rather funny effects.
